changelog:
Continue watching, and a licences page that lists its components again.

WHAT CHANGED

- The Movies and Series tabs start with a Continue watching row: the films and episodes you stopped partway through, most recent first, so you can pick one up without searching for it. One you finish drops off it.
- Settings, Playback has a new row, Keep in Continue Watching, from 7 to 90 days. A film you have not come back to in that time leaves the row.
- Settings, App, Open-source licences lists the components the app is built on again. It had shown none since 0.3.4.5: the list was never packed into the app, and the release now refuses to publish without it.
- Refreshing a source changes only what the provider changed: new channels are added, changed ones updated in place, and the rest left alone, so a favourite or a watched position on an unchanged channel is never touched.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pause and rewind live TV, the Live TV settings, and everything else from 0.5.5.

NOT YET

- The faster second refresh that the diff makes possible has been measured on a developer's device only; the timing on a phone with a full catalog is still to be recorded.
